name: higgsfield
one_liner: Higgsfield offers a unified REST API for image, video, audio, and 3D generation with an asynchronous request lifecycle and MCP integration.
auth_notes: The Higgsfield API authenticates with an API key and secret issued from the Higgsfield Cloud dashboard (cloud.higgsfield.ai). Credentials are sent on the Authorization header using the custom "Key" scheme: "Authorization: Key {api_key}:{api_key_secret}".
access_notes: Create and manage server-side credentials in Higgsfield Cloud.

extras.rate_limits: Rate limits vary based on your subscription plan and model usage.
